However, this handler first checks `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (added in `packages/lib/constants.ts` as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`),
